map.⚠️ 护理规范要求：保护性约束每 2 小时应松解一次，观察局部血液循环及皮肤状况: ⚠️ Standard: protective restraint released once every 2 h to check local circulation and skin, each release >=15-30 min.

map.松解时需有专人陪护，防止意外: A dedicated attendant must supervise release to prevent accidents
map.记录每次松解时间及皮肤评估结果: Record each release time and skin assessment
